packageRules.description: Vite+ RC toolchain is pinned deliberately; upgrade only via `vp upgrade` (see AGENTS.md). Covers the vite-plus catalog entry, the `vite` alias to @voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core, and the pnpm-workspace overrides `vite`/`vitest`.
Renovate does not manage devEngines yet; keep packageManager in sync manually to avoid drift.
